tool_args.rationale: The five pilot rows have s_grad spanning only 0.018, below the stated threshold for identifying vmax and rho. Acquire the open-branch discriminating probe to add wide s_grad leverage before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the standard siphon model from the five pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The narrow s_grad span leaves vmax and rho collinear, so these observations do not identify the parameters reliably.
It costs more and does not target the stated wide-s_grad identifiability gap as directly.
It is irrelevant to the identified ambiguity and should not be purchased.
